prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create ONE production city-map building sprite for tianshu, early-to-middle Qing Jiangnan region, 17th–18th century. The supplied Song Jiangnan image is a REFERENCE for the realistic material detail density and camera, NOT an edit target: generate an entirely new building of the stated type. Orthographic camera yaw45 elevation30; 2:1 dimetric ground projection, BOTH ground axes slopes precisely +0.5 and -0.5, verticals upright, parallel edges, NO perspective. Original South-facing entrance faces screen LOWER LEFT. True transparent RGBA background, all subject and short contact shadow completely inside canvas with at least 10% transparent margins. Very thin flat rectangular ground footprint with all three front ground corners clear; no thick diorama plinth. Realistic ancient architecture sprite, softly weathered off-white lime plaster, charcoal gray small fired clay roof tiles, gray brick/stone bases, dark timber and fine wood lattice windows. Modest Qing-style brick gate surrounds and restrained small carved trim; no ubiquitous imperial gilding, no giant ornamental roof curls. Light screen UPPER LEFT, small soft contact shadow screen LOWER RIGHT. NO sky, horizon, landscape, road outside footprint, humans, animals, calligraphy, labels, pseudo-writing, numbers, signage, watermark, checkers, plastic, cartoon, modern objects. This is an original generic game composite inspired by regional surviving Ming/Qing architectural forms, NOT a restoration of a named monument. Subject: ONE utilitarian Qing Jiangnan stable, gray tiled long pitched roof on simple unpainted dark timber posts, white-plastered rear wall over gray brick plinth, THREE EMPTY horse stalls open to the LOWER LEFT with low timber dividers and mangers. No horses or people. Small covered fodder bay to right, one neat straw bundle and wooden bucket entirely inside. Not a manor, not a barn from Europe. Footprint EAST-WEST9m NORTH-SOUTH7m with a little compacted earth forecourt under the same thin rectangular ground boundary. CRITICAL GROUND GEOMETRY: front edge horizontal projection9 units, side edge7units; front rises toward left at26.565degrees and side rises toward right at26.565degrees, exact ground slopes+0.500,-0.500. Three front corners visible. No trees, courtyard walls or elaborate roof ornaments.
